name: Realtime Fan-out
summary: LISTEN/NOTIFY to SSE and WebSocket, with presence and live counters. No Redis, no separate broker service.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: REALTIME_MAX_CONNECTION_SECONDS
env.description: Hard lifetime for a stream before the client is asked to reconnect. Bounds a held connection's waiting Capacity-Hours and survives deploys.

env.name: REALTIME_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS
env.description: Comment-frame interval that keeps proxies from closing an idle stream.

env.name: REALTIME_MAX_CHANNELS_PER_CONNECTION
env.description: Ceiling on channels one client may subscribe to, so a single request cannot fan out unboundedly.

env.name: REALTIME_PRESENCE_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: How long a presence record survives without a heartbeat. Must exceed the heartbeat interval.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating the cron sweeper's trigger delivery.

triggers.description: Expire stale presence records and prune the event buffer. Connections die without unsubscribing, so presence needs a TTL reaper.
